hash_interpretation: Recovered-file SHA256 values are independently recomputed from downloaded usage JSON bytes. Source-prefix digests are declarations, compared against separately published model audits keyed by exact session/subagent source suffix. equal_digest means equality of the two published digest values, NOT an independently recomputed original-transcript hash. Whole-file audit hashes may include recovery/follow-up records and are not interchangeable with immutable prefixes; unequal whole-file hashes are not failures.
material_findings: Two recorded Sonnet requests lack final usage: pagy-1 scope1 request0 (provisional output16), faraday-2 scope3 request4 (provisional output4). Their output totals are not reliable; all other recorded requests have complete final markers.

Haiku rails-1 two subagents differ from audits: exact evaluation ends 06:29:54.111Z, audit cutoff 06:45:58.280Z; recovered prefixes39/25 lines versus audit520/627. Wider audit window independently explains non-comparability, not a source-byte integrity match.

Haiku rails-3 deepest subagent differs: exact evaluation ends 06:36:41.247Z, audit cutoff06:45:58.467Z; recovered291 lines/157 assistant rows versus audit569/313. Wider audit window explains non-comparability.

Haiku faraday-3 main prefix differs: recovered57 lines versus audit59. Haiku faraday-4 main prefix differs: recovered75 versus audit77, whose last timestamp07:39:02.426Z exceeds exact evaluated end07:37:38.598Z. No alternative prefix hash independently established.
limitations: No referenced native JSONL source exists in this orb. Cannot independently reconstruct original prefixes, establish source completeness, confirm per-source-line content/stop reasons or timestamps, or prove declared source hashes from original transcript bytes. JSON usage exports are not original transcripts.

Exact boundary strings, request timestamps, source-line ranges/order, final markers, counters and allowlists are internally verified; earlier model audits corroborate only their available fingerprints/counts/metadata and have heterogeneous count and cutoff definitions.

Integer assistantTurns in heterogeneous audits are recorded as definition_ambiguous rather than silently equated to distinct msg_ IDs. Explicit row/request counts are compared and disagreements retained. Prefix hash disagreements can reflect differing original-turn line cutoffs, including untimestamped metadata rows; no alternative hash match is invented.

New quota-interrupted attempts contain synthetic error issues excluded from native msg_ request totals. This matches the task context, but issue reason alone cannot prove an excluded row was a synthetic error without its original transcript.

One new attempt may have an in-flight unlogged request. All new recorded requests having final usage does not establish no omitted/in-flight requests. No cost/completeness conclusion is drawn from recorded totals.

Subagent discovery includes only collector-emitted scopes with requests. Missing/empty scopes, unlogged helper calls, original process environment, billing adjustments, and per-variant timestamps/stop reasons are not represented.
